reasons.plausibility: This is scientifically plausible because grain refinement and nanoprecipitate formation are recognized methods to increase domain wall pinning and thereby coercivity in magnetic alloys.
reasons.testability: The proposed side-by-side comparison of cold-rolled/annealed samples vs. controls with direct magnetic and microstructural measurements offers a clear and decisive way to test the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis provides a well-founded process route and a practical experiment design, making it directly relevant and valuable for researchers investigating magnetic high-entropy alloys.
